1100.title: EULA

controls: Click Next to scan for and help remove specific malicious software from your computer. For more information on this tool, please see the online documentation.
View a list of malicious software that this tool detects and removes.
This tool is not a replacement for an anti-virus product. To help protect your computer, you should use an anti-virus product. For more information, see Protect Your PC.
1200.title: Welcome

controls: Please choose a type of scan:
&Quick scan. Scans areas of the system most likely to contain malicious software. If malicious software is found, you may be prompted to run a full scan.
&Full scan. Scans the entire system. Note that this scan can take up to several hours on some computers.
&Customized scan. In addition to a quick scan, the tool will also scan the contents of a user-specified folder.
1300.title: Scan Type

controls: Malicious software was detected and partially removed from your computer. To help complete removal, it is recommended that you perform a full scan. Click Next to perform a full scan.
Note that this scan can take up to several hours on some computers. If you would rather continue without performing this scan, uncheck this box before clicking Next.
1500.title: Full Prompt

controls: Files on your computer have been modified by malicious software. To help repair these files, select an option below and click Next.
Note that some data loss is possible during this process and that the tool may not be able to restore some files to the original, pre-infection state.
1600.title: Disinfect

controls: The tool is helping to remove malicious software from your computer.
After this operation completes, the tool will provide you with a report of the malicious software that was detected and removed.
1700.title: Disinfect Progress

controls: To help complete removal you should:
· Click the scan results link to view manual removal steps.
· Run a full scan with an anti-virus product.
· Download Windows Defender Offline, an advanced malware removal tool, and perform a scan.
1800.title: Scan results

controls: Suspected malicious software was detected on your computer. You can help to improve the effectiveness of this tool by sending Microsoft additional information about this software.
Where possible, a copy of the suspected malicious software will be sent. To view the information that will be sent to Microsoft, click "View Details."
Would you like to send this information to Microsoft?
1900.title: Submission Prompt

controls: This tool helps remove the following malicious software. For information on specific malicious software, click an entry.
